title: Monkey Protocol
tagline: Feed, nurture and explore with your Monkey! Turn your favorite NFT into a Monkey or adopt one!
description:
Monkey Protocol is a game where you feed, nurture and explore with Monkeys.

Feed them Ethereum or Bananas to increase their Energy.

Take them on wild expeditions to find more Bananas.

Drop them off at daycare to increase their level and participate in even crazier expeditions.

Every day is an adventure with Monkey Protocol!
how_its_made:
Monkey Protocol is a collection of smart contracts that allow users to adopt monkeys, perform actions with monkeys, and earn bananas.



It was developed with hardhat and react. The NFT data for adopted monkeys is stored nft.storage and the website is hosted on web3.storage.



We also used OpenZeppelin smart contracts and web3modal.
